concepts.definition: a word used to name a person, place, thing, or idea
a word that expresses an action, occurrence, or state
a word that describes or modifies a noun or pronoun
a word that modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb
a word used in place of a noun or noun phrase
a word showing the relationship of a noun or pronoun to another word
a word used to join words, phrases, or clauses
a group of words that expresses a complete thought
a group of words containing a subject and a predicate
a group of related sentences developed around one main idea
